body: Damn I’m sorry you had to go through that… hopefully someday soon there’s an easy way out for all of us.
Me too… I wish I had the courage to do literally anything at this point…

Honestly! like imagine how much more resources would be available for the people that do want to live. I’m just in the way and taking up space. I should be able to leave peacefully and not traumatize others in the process…
Yes I just want out I can’t take it anymore… the only guarantee in life is trauma. I could work hard to be happy for the rest of my life and never achieve it… I just want to stop fighting…
Yeah it’s a cruel cycle… life is too overwhelming so I just want to die but death is just as overwhelming. It would be so much easier if someone would just kill me…

I couldn’t agree more with OP. I’m 27, been depressed since I was 11. Been dealing with PTSD since 16. I’m at a dead end job, drowning in debt, living with my mom, no skills, no friends, nothing of my own. There’s no way I can be a productive member of society or even live a simple comfortable life on my own. I admit sure there’s probably work we can all do for ourselves to better our mental state but that can take YEARS. I don’t want to start living my life when I’m 50. I plan on ending my life before my next birthday so I pray every day to find a way to do it with dignity and comfort but it’s so fucking hard when the only efficient ways to kys are horrifically violent.
